items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Everything was about Mozart, Tchaikovsky, Beethoven, Bach.

ctx.x: Did you study Mozart and the European composers on the violin?

Oh well I didn’t get that far thanks God. But my favorite violin concerto is Tchaikovsky. Tchaikovsky, Mendelssohn, those are my two favorite. But I didn’t get that far. But one thing though, the musical training information in Cuba for many years, even after I left in © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-
1980, was strictly classical. Everything was about Mozart, Tchaikovsky, Beethoven, Bach. Nothing about Afro-Cuban music or Cuban music in general.
